title: Transformers #6
desc: THE NEW ERA OF TRANSFORMERS CONTINUES! Optimus Prime and Megatron are forever changed as the war between the Autobots and Decepticons takes unexpected and violent turns. If even these two powerful leaders are vulnerable, is anyone in the Energon Universe truly safe? Comics visionary ROBERT KIRKMAN (THE WALKING DEAD, INVINCIBLE), JASON HOWARD (THE ASTOUNDING WOLF-MAN), and LUDO LULLABI (GHOST PEPPER) present the next action-packed epic in the record-breaking TRANSFORMERS series. Collects TRANSFORMERS #31-36
